compliance.status: settled; compliance hearing held January 10, 2023; HEFSP adopted June 6, 2025

notes: DCA calculated present_need=166, prospective_need=381. City calculated prospective need of 331. NJ Builder's Association challenged. Settlement reached: prospective need = 359 units (settled Nov 2, 2022; compliance hearing Jan 10, 2023). RDP=0, all 359 = unmet need. Fourth Round compliance uses modified/extended Third Round overlay zones plus expanded mandatory set-aside (20% for 5+ units). New substitute sites were created in place of some removed AHO zones. Prior round credits: Flatrock Square (Block 2605 Lot 2.03) = 14 aff; Westmoor Gardens, Habitat, etc. = total 95 credits. CORRECTIONS to candidate snapshot: present_need was listed as 79 (WRONG — correct is 166 per DCA and HEFSP); prospective_need was listed as 381 (DCA figure — settled obligation is 359).
